title: Royal Holloway, University of London
description: Royal Holloway's official brand colour guidelines define the primary colours Brick Orange (#EB641E), Slate Grey (#202A30), Almond (#FFF1DF) and French Grey (#B4C4D0), and the secondary colours Pink (#F17CB0), Dark Blue (#0A6EC4), Light Blue (#1FD7FA), Purple (#BDBBFF), Green (#00B585) and Light Green (#CCED2B).
